description: Photograph of Vice President Mike Pence on an airport tarmac beside a SWAT officer in tactical gear whose vest carries a 'SHERIFF' patch, a name tape reading 'SGT. M. PATTEN', and a red-and-black 'Q' (QAnon) patch; a blue-and-white VIP aircraft consistent with Air Force Two is behind them. The image is overlaid with the caption 'All for a LARP right? Q' and an inset screenshot of Q drop #174 ('Effort to Silence Q', 20 Nov 2017). News reporting identified the officer as Broward County (FL) Sheriff's Office Sgt. Matt Patten at Fort Lauderdale, November 2018; the meme presents the patch as validation that Q is not a LARP.
